periods.name: 反射飞弹导入半圆魔法阵
periods.summary: Kinji calculates a midair interception point, Monkey teleports him there, Lucifelia opens Carbuncle's half-circle array, Kinji physically redirects the Refleks missile, and Hilda closes the array after the missile enters the interdimensional gap.
periods.outcome: The team survives the final weapon and the Chhat crisis ends.
